item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00055","case1_error":"Assumes an unsupported initial count of zero and uses inconsistent cookie-removal updates.","case2_error":"Counts three face cards instead of twelve and three red cards per rank instead of two.","reason":"The first invents an initial state and mishandles inventory; the second miscounts card categories across suits.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00056","case1_error":"States 120 without deriving Michael’s or Joyce’s durations or calculating the requested total.","case2_error":"Reports only outbound gas costs, omitting tolls and all return-trip costs.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported final total after partial correct work; the second explicitly calculates an incomplete subset of the requested costs.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00057","case1_error":"Uses purchase cost per egg instead of the stated selling price to calculate capital recovery.","case2_error":"Sets feeding cost equal to purchase cost, omitting the specified 20% increase.","reason":"The first confuses selling price with unit cost; the second fails to apply a percentage increase to the correct base.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00058","case1_error":"Uses twelve birds per snake instead of three, substituting the beetle-consumption rate.","case2_error":"Identifies the first growth year as the current year and reports 300 despite calculating the third-year value, 675.","reason":"The first substitutes the wrong rate; the second selects the wrong time point. Its explicit year misidentification goes beyond answer-marker conflict.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00059","case1_error":"The answer marker says 300, but the explanation correctly calculates and concludes that 200 remains.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the key-chain purchase expression as two pieces; fourteen dollars buys seven bundles, totaling twenty-one pieces.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict with an otherwise correct derivation, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
